Migrated 36 calls across 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Every file parses, and a smoke run shows only `execute` reaching the driver.

I left two spots alone on purpose:

| Spot | Why |
|---|---|
| `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` (2 calls) | Header says vendored copy, do not edit, changes lost on upgrade |
| 25 `cache.query(...)` calls | Different object, takes a cache key not SQL |

The vendor file still calls the deprecated form. That needs an upstream fix or a wrapper. Want me to add one?
